text: The paper reports consistently positive GD and GC gaps (except where models cannot do the task), a positive CD gap for topic-based summarisation and 3-SAT but a negative one for Addition and RACE, and an approximately constant CD gap across model scale for summarisation. The authors say this suggests gaps are task-specific and that it is not apparent whether the CD gap can be closed in general.
title: Gaps appear task-specific; not apparent whether the CD gap can be closed in general
